historical_scope: Rounds 1245-1246 only; both are contaminated live-history diagnostics, not clean holdouts and not prospective evidence.
method: Read-only comparison of preserved pre-draw recommendation artifacts, original post-draw review notes, the canonical result rows through cutoff 1250, and the current structured historical closed-loop index. No model, weights, thresholds, candidate ranks, or purchase policy were changed.

round_1245.decomposition: Candidate-stage failure: only one winning number survived the preserved 18-slot portfolio union; any2+ was impossible before considering within-line allocation.

round_1246_v2.decomposition: Candidate-stage recall was two of six; no line concentrated those two into a 2+ result.

round_1246_fallback.decomposition: Clear allocator/assembly failure on this diagnostic: four winning numbers were present in the union, but every line had exactly one hit. This is one historical case, not evidence that a particular allocator is generally superior.

structured_index_reconciliation.finding: The structured historical closed-loop status does not index the two preserved post-draw review notes or the 1245 error-note aggregate as review records. This is an inventory/scope gap; it does not invalidate the purchase-confirmation exclusion.
recommended_schema_separation: recommendation_review_inventory: every preserved pre-draw recommendation plus its post-draw review, whether or not purchased
verified_actual_purchase_inventory: only user-confirmed purchases or receipt-backed purchases

purchase_provenance.treatment: All reviewed sets remain preserved recommendations/designs, not verified actual purchases. Do not infer purchase from filenames or review wording.

conclusions: 1245 illustrates candidate recall failure before allocation.
1246 fallback illustrates candidate numbers surviving the union but being dispersed across lines.
The 1245 and 1246 review notes exist but are not represented in the current structured review index.
The review-index gap must be fixed without converting unconfirmed recommendations into purchase records.
next_actions: Add a separate recommendation-review inventory in a future audited master run, preserving the existing actual-purchase registry unchanged.
Retain 1246/1247/1248 source conflicts as unresolved until receipt or explicit confirmation exists.
Do not use 1245-1248 diagnostic outcomes to tune 1251 thresholds or claim prospective performance.
